notes.title: CUTE RAGE: Chick and Piggy
notes.content:
Here’s another update to make your experience in Game Over Please even more fun (or frustrating, depends on your point of view)! Let’s get into the details because I know the pain and frustration are already hitting hard, but don’t worry, we’re here to give you that little push you need to keep suffering in style:

Brand New HUD!
The interface has been revamped! Now it’s cleaner and, of course, more annoying across multiple screens. Oh, and there’s a new mode selection screen so you can choose how you want to torture yourself!

New Skins, baby!
Two new skins for the ball are here! We’ve got the Chick (nope, you’re not escaping it) and the Pig (get ready to suffer with cuteness). Say goodbye to the basic ball!

Difficulty Adjustments!
We’ve made improvements to several levels to try to balance out this madness a little. Now the difficulty adjusts more fairly... or maybe not. It all depends on your mood, of course.

Tips for the poor souls!
If you're one of those who die more than expected, relax! Now there are tips in the levels to give you a hand... maybe even a "step-by-step" to help you not get lost so much.

New Achievements, who can handle it?
We added 11 new achievements for you to kill yourself trying to unlock. It’s not going to be easy, but hey, that’s where the fun is, right?

Provocations, of course!
Yeah, I know you love being called a noob... so get ready, because new provocations are here to make your suffering even more... fun. It’s not just the game mocking you, I’m in on it too!

New Visual Effects
Now, in addition to stressing out over the ball, you’ll also have new visual effects on the ball and NPCs to get you even more distracted. More ways to lose focus and screw up!

And what’s coming next?
I know you’re all waiting for new levels and challenges, and I know some of you have already reached the end of the game (will we ever have peace?). Don’t worry, more cool stuff is on the way. But for now, the pain will continue, and it will be totally worth it... I promise. 😈

So, fasten your seat belts, and good luck... you’re gonna need it!

notes.title: Small fixes
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45146844/aac3cecd5eb39cf5863d73974e2080d6b925541a.jpgGame Update - Game Over Please

In this update, we focused on improvements to make your experience even smoother and more immersive. Check out the main highlights:

- Now, the stage number you’re playing is displayed directly in the pause menu. Just press "Esc" to access it and easily track your progress.
- Enhanced the PAUSE menu interface with a refined visual touch.

-Important Fixes- 
We implemented a fix for the bug reported by a player, where the ball couldn’t be moved at the start of the stage. With this update, all stage elements now position correctly before allowing ball movement, ensuring more stable gameplay.

Thank you for playing Game Over Please and for all the support and feedback that help us improve. Stay tuned, as we're working on new content and exciting updates coming soon!

notes.title: 👾 IT's ALMOST TIME!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45146844/d9136db12617b6a9338bf260c85fbc7766ef9dcf.png
Game Over Please is just one day away from its official release, and I couldn't be more excited to share this with all of you!

I know many of you have already taken a sneak peek at the trailers, the mechanics, and of course, the frustrations that this game can bring. But tomorrow, on 17/10, it will finally be available for everyone to dive into this insane journey of 95 levels. And, as always, I couldn't let this moment pass without a good old challenge! I hope to see you suffer... I mean, have fun ✌🏼💖

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45146844/68ff5024d0c87ae33b54936b08f612fdc794b9a4.png

🎯 Challenge #1: The Ultimate Test!
You all know how the game works, right? Your goal is simple: guide the ball to the final pipe in each stage. Sounds easy? Well... it just sounds easy! And that’s why tomorrow, on launch day, I’m setting a special challenge: who can reach the end of the game on the same day?

That’s right! I’m launching the main challenge: who will be the first to complete all 95 levels and reach the final pipe? For those who’ve played a bit during testing or are familiar with this type of game, it might take between [spoiler]30[/spoiler] and [spoiler]40[/spoiler] minutes to finish, if you’re sharp with the controls. But as I always say: the game has a funny way of surprising you, and sometimes you end up spending more time on stages you thought would be easy (we've all been there, right?).

Now, if you think 95 stages are too many for Day 1, don’t worry! The important thing here is to participate and have fun. And I'll be keeping an eye on who will be the ultimate master of the pipes on launch day!

🧩 Levels and Traps... or Disappointments?

So, since we're talking about challenges, I think it’s worth sharing some tips (or maybe not) about the levels that could make your head spin. I promise not to give too many spoilers, but here are some moments that could be memorable (and maybe painful 😜):


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45146844/a6a15f04c389c80a1466f3c0a787dbaf0d854186.jpg

I'll hide the spoilers...

Stage [spoiler]15[/spoiler]: This is the first big turning point. You’ll need to get the timing just right to break through the barriers the stage throws at you. It’s not just a test of precision, but also patience. Every mistake here will cost you, but once you get the hang of it… it’ll be beautiful (or maybe not!).

Stage [spoiler]26[/spoiler]: No barriers, no blocks. Seems like paradise, right? Wrong! This is when agility takes center stage. Here, you’ll need quick fingers and cat-like reflexes to control the ball and move forward. Honestly, this stage might seem easy at first glance, but trust me—it’s a trap! Precision is everything here.

Stage [spoiler]31[/spoiler]: This one deserves a special mention. I’m not giving full spoilers, but I can say that some of you will find this stage particularly annoying. Why? Well, because there are certain crucial spots hidden in the map that will make your life a lot easier… but finding those spots? That’s the challenge! At first, you might bang your head a little, but trust me: with a bit of pain, you’ll find the right path 😬.

🔥 More Challenges Ahead! Since I know you all love to compete and share your victories (and defeats), the idea is to keep this spirit of challenge alive even after the launch.

Plus, I’ll be around on launch day, following along with you all, giving some moral support (or maybe laughing at the frustration... just kidding!). If you need tips or get stuck on any stage, don’t hesitate to shout for help! Who knows, I might drop an extra hint in the comments? Capture screenshots, share your pain or your trophy with us.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45146844/ef46e4870f874fb18ad55ac818eda39c28018cd8.png

So, Are You Ready for the Launch? So, my friends, get ready for Game Over Please! Tomorrow, October 17, the game will be available on Steam, and I can’t wait to see who will be the first to conquer the main challenge. The path won’t be easy, but I promise every victory will be rewarding!

For those starting the journey tomorrow: I wish you luck, patience, and get those mice ready, take a deep breath, and good luck! See you at the launch! 👾🎮
